tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa'i dbu lags so//

༄༅// "$ gangs can rgyud 'khrungs 'gro ba'i don du yang*// bsgrub la gtsor mdzad rje btsun chen po yi// zhabs la btud de de nyid rnam thar nyid/ ma 'ong skal ldan don du bri bar bya// de la rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'di yi rnam thar ni/ yon tan brjod kyi mi langs pa yin pa dang*/ cung zad brjod par bya ste/ 'di la dang po rigs dang 'brel ba dka' ba spyad pa'i yon tan ni/ bod yul kha ba can gyi yul 'go bal po dang khad nye ba/ rgya bod thams cad 'drim pa'i lam/ 'phags pa thugs rje rang byung 'byung ba'i gnas/ de yang mi ring ba zhig ste/ gung thang gi rtsa zhes bya bar/ rigs ni khyung po ste/ yab ni shes rab rgyal dang*/ yum 'bro za dar 'od zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs ste/ sring mo yang te pa teb cung zhes bya ba gnyis ste/ lcam sring gsum mnga' ba las/ der yab sras kun la pha spun drag rtsal can mang pos kyang*/ cha rkyen bag re phrogs te/ shin tu kha nyen bar yod pa'i dus su/ yab shes rab rgyal na re/ yo skol la yon tan gyi kha ma bzungs nas/ skyid med pas khyod kyis dbus gtsang mthil na mar la song la/ mthu ser slobs cig gsungs nas/ cha rkyen mang du bskur bas/ der dbus su 'ongs te yar lung du snyag ston khrom rgyal la nor mang du phul te ser ba zhus nas bsgrubs pas/ dus der yul du ser ba 'bebs pa'i ser gta' skyel ba la/ mi stobs che ba gnyis dang 'grogs nas phyin te/ snga ma res phabs/ phyir lo gsum du de ltar phabs/ phyi ma res la ser gta' nub mo bskyal nas thun gtor/ mtho rangs yar 'ongs ste ri la slebs tsam na/ ser ba chen po byung*/ brag la gabs pas rngon pas mthong ste/ yul mi la sbran pas/ gnyis po bros pas thar/ zla bo gcig zin pa la brten nas dum phyung*/ der yul gyi mi dang 'cham byas/

gzhan tsho la sgos su mthu byas te/ rong du lha rje gnub chung ba la mthu zhus pas te/ dgra rnams tshar bcad de/ srog ser gnyis ka mthar thon par byas/ der yang skyo ba yang skyes te/ ser ba 'di yang sdig pa'i las yin pas/ chos gcig bya dgos bsam nas/ la stod dang rong gnyis byed pa'i lha rje rong ston lha dga' zhes bya ba/ rdzogs chen dang bsgrub pa sde drug la sogs pa mkhyen pa'i gsang sngags rnying pa ba che ba gcig yod par 'dug pas/ rnam bzhag byas te/ rdzogs pa chen po mnyan ba'i dus su/ 'bre ston gyi nged kyi dam chos rdzogs pa chen po bya ba 'di theg pa rim pa dgu'i yang rtse yin/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga bya ba yin/ de'i bshad srol btod pa la dus da lta nga bas mkhas pa med/ nged kyi 'di rtsa ba gtan zug yin te/ gzhi gtan la 'bebs/ rtse mo byung rgyal yin te/ 'bras bu gtan la 'bebs/ kha gser dang kha g.yu yin te 'di zabs/ zur bzhi logs dang bcas pa yin te/ mkha' ltar mas phubs nas las rgyu 'bras la ched du mi byed pa yin zer zhing spro ba bskyed yang skabs skabs tsam na kho de nged kyi 'dis kyang ma byung*/ gzhi rang gcig pu'i thog tu lus/ lta ba kha 'byams su song*/ bsgom pa la 'bog ma thon/ spyod pa la nyams kyi rtsi dang bral/ 'bras bu la sangs rgyas ma phebs pas/ 'dis kyang mi 'ong bar 'dug zer skad der smras pa/ 'o na slob dpon rang na re/ nged kyi rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga 'di/ theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse yin/ nang rtogs nas nang sangs rgyas/ nub rtogs na nub sangs rgyas/ 'di la lhag pa'i chos gzhan med zer ba byas pas/ bu de ltar min te/ de kun yo bla ma'i gsung sgros rkyang pa yin/ lta ba'i khyer so legs par 'dug zer/ nged kyi rnying pa'i 'di byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa chad pas/ nga rang la yang ci la zer bab med gsungs nas/ pha ki lho brag bya ba na mar pa lo tsā bya bas/

rgya gar du lan gsum byon nas/ rje nā ro chen po dngos dang mjal nas da lta yod zer/ de la gsang sngags kyi pha rgyud ma rgyud thams cad kyi gdams ngag tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas par byed pa/ rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel lus la 'grig pas sangs rgyas pa bsre ba 'pho ba bya ba/ mchog dang thun mong gnyis kar thob pa gcig yod par 'dug /lo tsa ba de nyid kyang kha glu dang mi 'bral mgur len/ lag pa gar dang mi 'bral phyag rgya bsgyur ba/ sems ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral ba 'od gsal rgyun par shar bas mnyam rjes med pa gcig yod par 'dug /nga rang yang der 'gro'o snyams ste/ nga dag khong gis bsgom du yod 'dug pas ngas srog rtsol bsgom mi nus gsungs te/ khong la bla ma la mos gus gcig pu byas nas/ bla mas ci gsung byas pas 'bad rtsol gzhan mi dgos par dus tshod gcig tu sdig sgrib thams cad dag ste/ rtogs pa 'char ba yod par 'dug ste/ rang re'i rdzogs pa chen po bzhin du go yul dang thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ba'i/ don spyi'i rnam par shar ba rtogs pa byas/ zhi gnas lteng po re la bsgom pa byas nas/ ngas lhag mthong rtogs zer kyang lta spyod 'dzol ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams thams cad dang khyad gcig yod par 'dug ste/ gsungs nas/ der gnyis ka der 'dongs ngam gsungs nas gnyis ka 'gro ba'i grabs byas pas 'bre ston yis zer ste/ da nga rgas pas tshe 'dir mi mjal ba'i phyi mar smon lam 'debs zer ro// der mi las bsams pas ga re slob dpon 'di tsho thams cad tshig bzang po 'ba' zhig 'dug ste/ slob dpon rang la yang chi cug 'gro cha mi 'dug /de bas nga rang yang lo tsa ba de'i drung du 'gro bar zhu sems nas mos pa dung dung ba gcig byung nas/ slob dpon nga lho brag lo tsa ba de'i drung du 'gro bar zhu byas pas/ bu rung khyod rang de'i drung du 'gro ba legs/

nga ni ma thon ba yin gsungs skad/ der lho brag tu byon te/ phyis rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ 'bre ston de yang bla ma bzang po gcig yin par 'dug /gzhan yin na gtong du mi ster gsungs skad do// de nas bla ma mar pa lo tsa ba dang*/ mkhyen lung dgon par mjal te/ chos dang zang zing gnyis ka zhu byas pas/ gnyis ka mi 'ong gcig bya zer skad/ phyag rten ras shar gcig dang bur ltang gcig yod gsung*/ lung pa de na yar glu blangs pas/ ston ka yin pas nyi ma gcig la nas khal bdun rnyed pas/ khyod mi dgod chos dgod 'ong ba gcig 'dug gsung nas/ lar nyi ma bzhi la nas khal nyi shu tsam rnyed pas/ bla ma dgyes skad/ yul de'i smad du mar pa nag po dang 'gras pas/ zhabs tog tu ser ba byas/ dus der gtsang nas mes tshon pos 'bul ba bskyal ba zhing zho gcig mal gcig tshos lta bur ltang la sogs pas gang ba la/ mdo mang po ti sum cu rtsa gcig dang*/ mkhar dgu thog gcig byed pa la de'i rdo skyed pa'i dus su/ rdos sgal pa byung ba la sgal khang byas nas rdo khur bas/ ar po mi bcu gsum yod/ der lo re la thog re zin/ gzhan dag na re thog gsum phubs nas gdams ngag gnang yang zer ro// de la thog lnga thon dus su/ rgyud kyi bshad tshod kyi gzhung dang*/ dbang byin rlabs ni mang du thob bo// thog bdun tshar ba'i dus su/ a ma jo mo'i zhal nas/ bu 'di dka' ba dpag tu med pa rje btsun nyid kyi dka' ba spyad pa lta bu byas/ lo yang mang du song gsung nas/ 'di la gdams ngag 'debs par zhu byas pas/ thabs lam gyi skor dang*/ bsre 'pho'i gnad mang du gnang*/ dbang rdzogs kyang lan lnga thob/ gsang mtshan bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan du btags so// rje mi la'i sems la dran pa de lo tsa bas mkhyen nas bu khyed rang rngog gi phyir song la gdams ngag zhus cig /sang gnangs tsam na 'dir shog zer te/ rngog gis 'bul ba bskyal ba'i phyi nas gdams ngag zhus te/

ri bo'i mi la phug bya ba da lta yang yod pa der bsgoms/ ri bo na yod tsa na/ rngog gis 'bri g.yag dol kyi g.yal mo bas khyer ba dang*/ de la ser ba phabs/ der da rung rngog gis ser ba yin nges med zer ba la/ yang bskyar bas lo tog thams cad rdul du brlags/ der shing phung re re'i rtsa na yang bya bye'u thu ba re shi ba'i ro btums te/ bla ma la yus gsol te/ nga 'dod pa'i dge ba 'dod pa la/ sdig pa 'di 'dra byas gsung pas/ rngog na re bu nga la bla ma mar pas nā ro pa la lan gsum zhus pa'i tha ma la gsungs pa'i gdams ngag /su la yang ma byin pa khyod la sbyin gsungs nas/ a tung gnang ngo*// der lho brag nas jo mos 'phrin bskur ba dang*/ nga yang rngog 'bul ba skyel ba'i nye gnas byas te/ lho brag tu byon nas/ gdam ngag bskyar ba zhus dgos/ de nas lhor bzhud bzhed pa nas/ lho nas rnam zhag byas pas/ bde mchog snyan rgyud gsang ba rin po che dbang byin rlabs dang*/ gdams ngag jo mo lhan cig skyes ma dang bcas pa gnang ngo*// dgyes rdor gdams pa bshad dang*/ gsang 'dus rigs lnga gdan gcig la bsgom pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par mdzad nas/ khyad par du lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu la lnga gnang lhag ma bzhi rgya gar na lus pas tshol gcig gsungs so// rje mar pas khyod snying rus che bas/ bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa gcig 'dug pas nyams len gtso bor gyis cig gsungs nas/ gdams pa nan tan tu gsungs te/ de nas gtsang du byon// rgya gar du 'gro bar bsam pa las gser med pas ma thon/ bla ma'i gsung gis nyams len gal che gsungs nas bsgrub pa la zhugs so// ༈ gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel pa nyams su myong ba'i yon tan ni/ der rang yul du phyin pas pha ma gnyis snga mo shi bas/ zhing kun yang tha bar song*/ khang thog tu rtsa skyes/ sgo yang zhig dang bar lug pas/ de'i nub mo rang gi khangs par gzims pas/ kye ma 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'di 'dra snyam pas mgur blangs pa/

kye ma 'khor ba'i snying po med// mi yod nor med snying po med// nor yod mi med snying po med// ma yod bu med snying po med// bu yod ma med snying po med// thams cad 'dzom yang snying po med// dgos rgu tshang yang snying po med// snying po med pa'i dus 'di ru// rnal 'byor snying po ces mi blangs// ces gsung skad do/ de nas phyi de nang par slob dpon gcig la zhing khang kun phul nas/ dbyar de rang yul gyi ri brag nag bya ba la bsgoms/ brgyags med pas tshod ma za 'thungs ste/ gos med pas thul kog gcig gi smad nas brags te stod du klan ba byas/ sring mo te pas ni snam bu gcig byin nas phyir la gtad/ dus gcig na zhang ne mo gcig dang sring mo te pas chang bum pa gang 'ongs pas 'thung ma nus/ der ni mtshan gnyis po na re nged kyi ming po 'di bzhin du song zer nas bltas pas/ rus 'go pags kyis g.yogs pa tsam du 'dug ste/ yang ri la bros nas bsgoms pas de'i dus su/ nyams kyi gtum mo bya ba mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan te/ tsog pu'i gnad kyi lus kyi bde ba btsal/ srog rtsol gyi chings kyis bar gyi ngag gi bde ba 'bar/ srol mdud kyi gshis kyi sems kyi bde ba sgom pas/ nyams rtogs dpag tu med pa de nas thon gsung ngo*// dus gcig tsam na lung pa'i mda' ru/ ru ba tshan gcig byung ba'i nang na ne ne mo gcig 'dug pas/ brgyags med pas rked pa bskris pas skrur phyin tsam na/ sbra rtsa na mar phyin tsam na/ ne ne mos tshug shing thogs nas ded du byung*/ yang bros pas brag gseb tu bsgoms/ bya rgod kyi sgro thu ba dang rngon pa 'dra ba en re tsam mthong*/ za tshod byas shing bsdad pa la/ lan gcig rngon pa 'ga' dro 'debs pa'i rtsar bskrus pas/ lus la za spu skyes pas/ the'u rang yin snyams nas ded du byung ba la/ nga mi la thos pa dga' yin byas pas skad ngo shes par byung nas dro phye mang du byin/

brgyag skyel zer ba la so so'i g.yengs bas brjed do// dus gcig tsam na chang sa gcig tu sprang mo gcig bskrus pa la/ khyod su yin byas pas/ nga khyung po za yin/ pha ma med/ ming po mi la thos pa dga' bya ba yin te/ ri khrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin bas gar shi cha med zer/ der ming po lung pa 'di gad bya ba'i brag la yod byas pas dga' nas skrun zan rkyal pa gang po khyer nas song bas/ de la zla ba gnyis tsam yi brgyags byas/ de nas sring mo de lan re bskrus pas thams cad bskyal gsungs/ der ri khrod nags khrod 'ba' zhig 'grims te/ rag ma'i byang chub nam mkha' rdzong bya ba la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu las/ rmi lam su rmo rko byas pa rmis pas/ de'i mgur ni// ༈ mnyam pa nyid kyi sa gzhi las// dad pa sngon 'gro'i chu lud g.yogs// bdud rtsi lnga yi rlan gyis sbangs// 'khrul rtog med pa'i sa bon btabs// gnyis med glang po dor brdabs nas// thabs dang shes rab gshol btags te// dam tshig yengs med chang zungs nas// brtson 'grus drag po'i lcags kyis brabs// tha ba sra yang phed de mchi// 'bras bu dus su bsnyin ste mchi// zhing pa'i dpe dang sbyar ba 'di// rnal 'byor pa yi rmi lam lags// rmi lam mi ngan bzang ba rmis// tshig tsam don la skyes pa med// mtshon pa tsam las ma skyes pas// slad kyis byang chub bsgrub pa rnams// nyams su len na 'di bzhin long*// ces gsungs ste/ 'di min kyang ting 'dzin dang 'brel pa'i nyams su myong ba'i yon tan yin mod kyang*/ 'on kyang zhib tu byed na/ gsum pa khyer so bstan pa'i yon tan ni/ de nas dbyar brag ri la bsgoms/ dgun nags gseb tu bsgoms pas/ ku thang phye yul gyi brag gar spo mthon rdo rje rdzong la bsgoms pa'i dus su/ mgur bzhengs pa// ༈ brag gar spo mthon nam mkha'i rdzong*// nam mkha'i rdzong gi dkyil shed na// steng na lho sprin smug po 'thibs// 'og na chab rgyal rtsang po 'phyo/

logs la thang kar rgod po lding*// bar na gcan gzan mang po rtse// de lta bu yi dben gnas bde// 'du 'dzin med pa'i dgon pa bde// nyal ba med pa'i 'dug lugs bde// grang ba med pa'i ras gos bde// na tsha med pa'i sgyu lus bde// 'dzin chags med pa'i 'gro 'dug bde// zhum pa med pa'i rtul shugs bde// 'di drug lus kyi khyer so lags// thabs dang shes rab bsgom pa bde// rgyun chad med pa'i bsam gtan bde// rang rigs 'od gsal rtogs na bde// gnyis su med pa'i lta ba bde// dbugs 'gro 'ong med pa'i ngang shed du// rnam rtog thams cad nub ste bde// lha bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi ngang shed du// lta ba thams cad 'dus te bde// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi ngang shed du// chos rnams thams cad 'dus te bde// 'di drug sems kyi khyer so lags// gdams ngag kha ru bton nas bzhag /nyams myongs glu ru blangs nas bzhag /chos nyid gtan la phabs nas bzhag /lta spyod zung du bsdebs nas bzhag /mang du bshad pas nyung du bsdus// phyi rabs rten kyi gang zag rnams// nyams su len na 'di bzhin long*// ces gsungs so/ ༈ /bzhi pa la phyi gangs can du bsgoms pas/ phyogs bzhir snyan pa'i grags pas khyab pa'i yon tan ni/ dus res shig na breng du phyin pas/ yon bdag dang slob ris mang du yod pa'i dus su/ yon bdag rdor mo gza' mis rje btsun la mchod gnas su zhus te/ phye bre do/ 'bras bre gang*/ sha gzugs cig /mar shag gcig bsnams nas/ bla ma sus bshol yang ma bzhed do// sngon la bzhud// brgyags gnangs skyel bar byas te/ kha ba nyin mtshan bco brgyad bab pas/ bla ma dug phugs su lus so// de'i dus su mi thams cad kyis gyod ka byas te/ bla ma khyed kyi sku la bar chod byas zer/ ma jo gdor mo yang rje btsun sku gshegs zer zhing le lan ded/ dbyar de nas zla ba bdun song ba'i dus su/

gdung rus tshol ba'i mi gsum brdzangs pas/ mis la ka nas ku btabs pas/ bla mas dud mda' byas pas/ yang na gcan gyis ri dwags bsad pa'i thed 'dra ba'am/ yang na rngon pas brgyags byin bas ma grongs sam/ srid dam sems pas 'ongs pa dang ri dwags chen po brag ka nag 'dug pa yang mthong*/ de nas brag rtsar phyin pas mgur gsungs pa thos pas yid ches/ spyan sngar phyin pas bla ma shin tu sku nyams shin tu che bar snang ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs pa'i lo rgyus gsungs te/ sngar gyi sha mar gyi phyed dang*/ 'bras bre gang phye da rung yod pa rnams la dro byas/ bla ma mi bzhud pa la khong gsum gyis dbang med byas te 'ongs pas/ la la kha bas mig mi phyid dam zhus pas/ legs par 'ongs gsungs nas 'ongs so// bla ma 'od nyi ma dang 'dra bar dro bar byung nas/ kha bas ma bsdigs par breng du slebs pa dang*/ yul mi rnams kyi sku khams bde 'am byas pas/ snyun lam la phyi'i gangs mgur gsungs pa ni// ༈ dpal di ring bkra shis khri gdug la// khyed phyag mjal gyi yon bdag pho mo rnams// yo skol ma shi phrad pas blo ba dga'// nga mi rgan glu yi gter mdzod yin// snyun dri med lan la glu yis mjal// yong stag gi lo yi lo bzhug gam// yos bu lo yi lo 'go la// wa brgyal zla ba yi nya drug la// 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba der// mi ngas kyang dben sa bsnyag tu phyin// der gnam sa gnyis kyi gros byas pas// skyibs ser rlung gis bang chen brdzangs// lho sprin smug po'i mdun ma bsdus// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa ltong la brgyus// khrims kyi gza' brgyad lcags su bcug /skar chen yongs la bud kyis btabs// bud kyis 'dangs g.yos pa'i tha ma la// kha ba nyin dgu mtshan dgu bab// kha ba nyin mtshan bcod brgyad bab// babs che ste che ba bal 'dab tsam// 'dab chags bya ltar lding zhing bab// 'bring ste 'bring ba 'phang lo tsam// bung ba lta bur 'khor shin bab// chung ste chung ba sran 'bru tsam// khum 'phang bzhin du 'dril shin bab// yang chung yungs kar tsam bab ste// lcags phye lta bur 'thul zhing bab// lar kha ba che chung tshad las 'das// mtho gangs kar rtse mo dgung dang mnyam// dma' rtsi shing nags tshal rgya zhor mnan// ri nag po rnams la sku dkar gsol// mtsho chu rlabs can la dar chags btabs// rtsang chab sngon mo sbubs su bcugs// sa mtho dman med pa thang du bsnyams// phu na mdung btsugs rtse ma mngon// skabs su gzhu btsugs mchog mi mngon// mda' na mda' btsug ltong mi mngon/

bab de ltar che ba'i ngang nyid kyis// spyir dbu nag mi la bzang btson byas// sgos ri dwags sman ma'i 'tsho ba bcad// rkang bzhi'i phyugs la mu ge byung*// 'bangs byol song kun la bka' nan babs// steng 'dab chags bya la brgyags chad byung*// 'og bra ba byi ba'i khang bu brdibs// de 'dra'i skya 'dangs kyi skal pa la// steng nas 'bab pa'i rgung spabs dang*// dgun lo sar sgang gi lhags pa gnyis// nga mi la ras pa'i ras gos gsum// gangs dkar gyi rtse la 'khrug pa shor// min na ras gos drod che sin// kha ba bab rgyal chab tu zhu// rlung 'a 'ur che yang rang zhir thal// spyir nang 'khrug med par gtan gnya' bgyis// spyir ci zer nyan bas kha yis blangs// rlung tsha grang gnyis ka bcud la btangs// nga gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge'i rigs// gnas gangs khong min par sdod ma myongs// mes kyi tsha bo stag slag can/ sdar wa slag gyon nas 'bros ma myongs// pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// sdang dgra la sta zur shor ma myong*// cha la rnal 'byor ras pa 'di// grub thob brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bsgrub brgyud bstan pa dar ste mchi/ grub thob kyang 'ga' re 'byung ste mchi// gtam snyan yang phyi nas bzlo ste mchi// sho mod kyang bre mos bgyis pa lags// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ste/ gur kar phubs nas zhag kha gcig bzhugs so/ ston rang yul mthong ba'i la kar phyin pas rtsas ma byed bdo ba gzigs pa dang*/ der 'gro ba sems pa gcig byung ba nas phyin te/ der ston mo byed pa gcig 'dug pa la bskrus pas/ mi gcig gis mi la thos pa dga' grub pa thob pa'i lo rgyus 'chad pa la/ yang gcig gis de nga'i mchod gnas byed zer tsa na/ gcig gis ngo shes nas 'di yin zhes bstan nas/ ngo mtshar che nga'i mchod gnas zhu zer tsam na/ khong chags yengs pa'i tshe bros pas nyin lam gsum gyi sar phyin pa'o//

༈ lnga pa seng gha la'i nags la bsgoms pas/ bsgoms nyams bde bar shar zhing rkang ting phug gi shel phug nam mkha' rdzong na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bde ba'i dbyangs blangs pa la/ ༈ me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i gnas// ljon shing gar thabs byed pa'i sa// spra spre'u yang tsal sbyong ba'i sa// bya skad sna tshogs sgrogs pa'i ri// de lta bu yi dben gnas su/ gcig pur 'dug na bde yang bde// 'du 'dzin med na yongs kyang bde// ngag la gleng brjod med na bde// smra ba nyung na yongs kyang bden// ting 'dzin bying rgod med na bde// sems nyid 'od gsal yongs kyang bde// lus la gtum mo 'bar na bde// grang dro med na yongs kyang bde// dbugs la 'gro 'ongs med na bde/ rgyu ba chad na yongs kyang bde// gnyis su med pa'i lta ba bde// zung du 'jug na yongs kyang bde// nor la 'dzin chags med na bde// zhen pa chung na yongs kyang bde// theg pa che chung med na bde// gcig pu rtogs na yongs kyang bde// spra ba'i 'bol stan 'og na bde// bal po'i shing ras lus la bde/ rang rig bde stong sems la bde// 'di rnams rnal 'byor spyod tshul yin// ces gsungs// ༈ skyid pa nyi ma'i rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ drug pa snang ba mthun rkyen du shar ba'i yon tan ni/ cir snang grogs su shar ba'i yon tan mgur du bzhengs pa/ chu shing ngang gis 'dzom tsam na// g.yog po zer ba rdzun du gda'// za rogs 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// skye 'gro sgyu mar rtogs tsam na// gnyen 'brel zer ba rdzun du gda'/ gdung sems 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// rang rig 'od gsal shar tsam na/ sgra tshad zer ba rdzun du gda'// tshigs tshogs 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// sems nyid rin chen gter snyed pas// nor rdzas zer ba rdzun du gda'// gser dngul 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// bsgom pa rang byung shar tsam na// rnam rtog zer ba rdzun du gda'// gnyen po 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// lus la gtum mo 'bar tsam na// gos glog zer ba rdzun du gda'// snal ma 'dis kyang dgos rgyu chung*// zhes gsungs pa'o//

༈ bdun pa nyams len rgyun chad med pas/ dran pa thams cad lam mkhan du shar ba'i yon tan ni/ rgyud dang phyed yul gyi bar gyi khu byugs dben pa rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ mgur bzhengs pa/ ༈ grub thob bla ma dam pa de// mun pa sel ba'i lam mkhan yin// skyo dub med pa'i dad pa de// bde 'gror 'dren ba'i lam mkhan yin// dbang po drug gi thug phrad de// rnam rtog sbyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// sku gsum 'bral med ting 'dzin de// rnam thar snyags pa'i lam mkhan yin// grang dro med pa'i ras gos de// zhen pa gtong ba'i lam mkhan yin// 'du 'dzin med pa'i dgon pa de// bsam gtan sbyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// lam mkhan drug gis sna drangs nas// mkhar gyi nang du 'jug kyang 'tshal// 'jigs kyis dogs nas mkhar gcig brtsigs/ mkhar ni chos nyid stong pa'i mkhar// da yongs 'jigs kyang mi dgos so// skyo yi dogs nas grogs gcig btsal// grogs ni bde stong gnyug ma'i grogs// da yong skyo ba mi gda'o/ 'khyags kyi dogs nas gos gcig btsal// gos ni gtub mo lhun grub go /da yongs 'khyags snyam mi bgyid do// nor gyis dogs nas lam gcig btsal// lam ni 'od gsal lam sna zin// da yong nor kyis dogs pa med// zhes gsungs so// ༈ brgyad pa chos brgyad 'go non pa'i yon tan ni/ sta so phrag dkar rdo rje rdzong la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ gra pa yang bco lnga skor re yod tsam na/ nyin gcig sngar gyi ne ne mo phyug mo de/ sha thud g.yag yu 'o gcig la bkal te g.yog gcig gis khrid/ mo rang bong bu zhon nas byung bas/ sring mo te pa shed na re/ ma ki rtsar nga 'thab tu 'gro ba yin/ sngon cang med tsam na nye ba med/ da mi dgos zer nas mjal du ma ster ste/ rje btsun gyis thabs byas ste/ mdun du yol ba'i phyi rol du 'dug tu bcug nas/ rgyal mo rtsa grong grong khyer du// nye 'brel dgrar lang ming sring gsum/

sran phung ber rga ltar 'thor nas// 'dris med yul du 'khyams dus su// ā ne zhes bya gcig kyang med// rtsa so dbu ma'i rdzong mchog der// bkres skom lcags kyis bskul gyur nas// btsal yang a ne ma rnyed par/ sprang po bslab 'tshongs shog gcig zer/ tshug shing thogs nas ded du byung*// a ne ming ni bdud mos su// gum bar nga shi bdud mos su// shu me kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// dus dang res ne ne phyag byad bzang*/ spyir 'jig rten mi la chag tshad med// nga mi la sha mar gyi dgos pa med// ces gsungs nas/ ne ne mos bden bden zer nas ngu shin thal skad/ dus da nas chos brgyad kyi 'go non par byung*/ chos brgyad rang grol mnyam nyid ngang*/ sgyu ma lus kyi zhing sos byed// sems nyid rin chen ba mo 'joms// ngo srung med pa'i yon tan skyong*// chos brgyad dgon pa'i rta mi rgyug /zhes gsungs so// ༈ dgu pa yab yum gyi drin lan sobs pa'i yon tan ni/ bskyangs pa nam mkha'i rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus su rje btsun la bon po gcig gis pha ma'i bdun tshigs zhus pas/ sring mo te pa na re nged rang gi pha ma la bdun tshigs ma byas par zer nas/ byas pa'i don du mgur du bzhengs pa/ ༈ lus kyi sha dor sems bre'u// 'dris bshes med pa'i rgyal khams su// gcig pur gnyis su 'khyams gyur pas// ting nge 'dzin gyi dgug gzhugs byas// sgyu ma lus kyi hom khung du// 'gro drug sa bon bud shing de// skye ba med pa'i ming byang btsugs// ro ni gsal stong ngang du sbyangs// bdun tshigs snang stong nyid du sbyangs// tsha tsha skye ba med par btabs/ zan ni bde ba chen por gtad// lam ni gnyis su med par bstan// bsngo ba phyag rgya chen pos byas// smon lam byang chub sems su btabs// pha ma'i drin lan 'khor te mchi// zhes gsungs so// ༈ bcu pa phyi rol gyi yul la thog rdugs med par shar ba'i yon tan ni/

yang dus res shig na gnas gzhi gcig gi rtsar phyin pas/ btsun pa 'ga' zhig na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di la zhag 'ga' mchod gnas byed zer nas tho 'tshams pa'i ched du/ lha khang gcig gi dbu rtser bzhag nas/ sgo la lcags bcugs nas bzhags pas/ phyir phyin tsam na phyi na 'dug /nang du bltas tsam yang nang du snang bas/ bsnyen bkur byas te bzod gsol byas te/ zhabs spyi bos blangs pa'i dus su/ der ston pa dar blo bya ba'i tshad ma rnying ma 'ga' tsam nyan pa gcig byung ste/ rtsod pa byas pas ston pas ma thub ste/ rje btsun gyi rtsod pas mi rdzi ba'i yon tan mgur du bzhengs pa/ ༈ ser sna'i mdud pa ma khrol bar// sbyin pa btangs pas ci la phan// rang sems g.yo sgyu ma spangs bar// tshul khrims bsrungs bas ci la phan// tshigs gi rtse mo mi thub pa'i// bzod pa'i phub cung ci la 'dzugs// 'khor ba'i lam 'phrang mi sgrol ba'i// brtson 'grus rta po ci la rgyug /gang snang chos skur mi 'gyur ba'i// bsam gtan bsgoms pas ci la phan// ngar 'dzin 'gong po mi chod pa'i// shes rab ral gris ci zhig gcod// rang sems dug sbrul ma zin ba'i*// thabs kyi zhags pas ci zhig 'dzin// ci byed chos su mi bsgyur bas// smon lam btabs pas ci la phan// rang sems rdo rus ma phrad par// ye shes skyes pas ci la phan// ngar 'dzin 'gong po ma thul ba'i// stobs kyi tho bas ci zhig rdung*// rang sems sangs rgyas mi tshol bar// thos pa che bas ci la phan// ma la ya bsgoms kyi nang du 'khyams// zhes gsungs so// ༈ bcu gcig pa ye shes kyi sgron me mnyam pa'i nyams kyi yon tan ni// thos chung rtsod pas pham pa dang*// nyams myong zhan zhing the tsom skyes// rnal 'byor pa yi 'phrang bzhi yang*// dang po gtug sa ma nor bar// nā ro pa yi sras la gtugs/ bar du bsgom sa ma nor bar/ brag gar spo mtho rdzong la bsgoms/ tha mar sdom sa ma nor bas// 'dris med bshes med yul du bsdoms/

zhes gsungs so// brag gar spo mtho rdzong la bsgoms pa'i dus su/ klu btsan dang brag btsan gyis dmag byung*/ nga lus lha'i rdzong la gnas/ ces pa'i mgur gsungs/ yang 'di skad gsungs/ gcig tu gsang sngags thab lam che// gnyis su bla ma'i gdams ngag che// gsum du rang nyid bsgoms sran che// 'di gsum che ba rnams gsum lags// gcig tu mkhas pa'i zhabs tog dgos// gnyis su rang la shes rab dgos// gsum du bla ma'i gdam ngag dgos// 'di gsum dgos pa rnam gsum lags// gcig tu phyag rgya mtshan ldan gces// gnyis su spyod pa glang chen gces/ gsum du bde stong dbyer med gces// 'di gsum gces pa rnam gsum lags// gcig tu tshig gi sdeb sbyor mkhas// gnyis su dri ba'i lan la mkhas// gsum du sems kyi mtshan nyid mkhas// 'di gsum mkhas pa rnams gsum lags// gcig tu mi yi tshogs su 'du// gnyis su mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du// gsum du longs spyod tshogs rnams 'du// 'di gsum 'du ba rnams gsum lags// gcig tu snang ba lhan por mthong*// gnyis su bde ba dngos med mthong*// gsum du tshigs dang bral bar mthong*/ 'di gsum mthong ba rnams gsum lags /gcig tu srog rtsol gnad du tshud// gnyis su sems nyid klong du tshud// gsum du chos la byan po tshud// 'di gsum tshud pa rnams gsum lags// de nas rnal 'byor mi sdod kyang*// bla ma sangs rgyas 'di nyid gsungs// rig pa ye shes sgron me gcig /rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo gnyis// ro snyoms phyi yi me long gsum// bde chen gsung gi rin chen bzhi// lus med rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi// chos bzhi rgya gar lus pa las// nga dbyar so rgas pas ma thon bas// rje nā ro'i slob ma yod srid kyis// ras chung ma 'dug rgya gar song*// ces gsungs nas/ der ras chung pa la gser srang gsum bskur nas/ rgya gar du btangs pa yin gsung ngo*//

༈ bcu gnyis pa lha'i skur gyur pa'i yon tan ni/ dus res zhig tsa na bla ma nags gsebs gcig na bzhugs// kar ti phug zhes bya ba der/ bal po'i rgyal pos ras ngo mtshar can gcig dang*// a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba gcig phul bas// bla mas ras te mnabs/ a ru ra de spyan la byugs kyin 'khor gyi nang du byon pa la/ bla ma la de dag sus phul zhus pas// mi'i rgyal po rigs kyi rje/ mi rgyal chos kyi spyan can kyis/ shing ras 'jam ba'i ras gos 'di// gtum mo lhun grub thos su phul// zhes gsungs so// ༈ yang rgya dang bod kyi phyogs bcur snyan pas khyab pa'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun la rgya gar gyi grub thob dha rma bod de phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pas/ bla mas mkhyen pas phar bzhud pa'am/ bal po rdzong gseb tu 'jal nas/ der dhar ma bod des ras yug gcig phyag rten byas pas/ phyis 'khor rnams kyis grub thob de lta bus phyag 'tshal ba la/ slob dpon gyis phyag lan mi byed pa ci lags zhus pas/ yid 'ong bal po rdzong gseb tu// bod kyi mi la ras pa la// rgya gar dhar rma bod de yis// sgyu ma lus kyi phyag byas nas// zung 'jug thal sbyar pus btsugs nas// sku khams phyag rgya chen por dris// brjod du med pa'i grong khyer du// rnal 'byor sku khams bde bar mchi// gnyis su med pa'i dgon pa nas// rnal 'byor sku khams bde'am byas// zhes gsungs skad do/ de'i dus su bod kyi mi la ras pa de la/ rgya gar rdar rma bod de phyag 'tshal zhes snyan pa che bar grags nas/ ltad mo ba dpag tu med pa tshogs nas/ phyag byas byin brlabs zhus pa las/ mi rnams na re/ mi la ras pa bya ba sgra che la don chung ba/ gcer bu ngo tsha med pa gcig 'dug /chos pa bya ba ni ba ri lo tsa ba ngo mtshar che ba yin/ chos gos legs par gzabs/ mi la zas nor sbyin/ gling lang snyan pa brjod yin zer nas rje btsun la ma dad de/

de'i tshe ma dad pa'i de bsal ba'i phyir/ bla ma seng ge bcibs nas nam mkha' la bzhud pa dang*/ shel gyi mchod rten 'od 'bar ba sprul nas/ skar mda' bzhin du gshegs par mdzad nas/ 'di skad gsungs te/ she'u sgang bar do'i sems bzhin du// bsgribs med thog rgyugs kun dang bral// bzungs mi zin cing gtangs mi thengs// skar mda' lta bu'i spyod 'gros 'di/ ma dad bsal phyir byas lags pas// da yongs spyod pa mi byed do/ gsung so// ༈ bcu gsum pa gzhan kyi spyod pa sel ba'i yon tan ni/ dus res shig na/ slob ma mang po nad kyi btabs pa las/ bla ma'i byin rlabs byas pa tsam gyis/ nad thams cad sol bar gyur to/ 'di skad gsungs ste/ bring gi la stod dgon pa ru// sgyu ma lus kyi dkyil krung byas// gnyis su med pa'i mnyam bzhag bcas// skye ba med pa'i dmigs pa las// yengs pa med pa'i blo bzhag nas/ ma rung sems phral slob mar gsal// zhi khro gnyis kyi dgug gzhugs byas// byams dang snying rje'i blo bzhag pas// ma rung stong phrag brgya bcu yi/ gdon bsal nad pa yo nas bslangs// tha mal lus kyi nad pa la// yi dam lha yi sman sbyor byas// gzungs 'dzin gnyis kyi nad pa la// gnyis su med pa'i sman sbyor byas// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams la// dam chos ro snyoms sman sbyor byas// bsal na nad kyang sol sol 'dra// zhes gsungs so/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang ye shes sems dpa' dbyer med du gyur pa'i yon tan ni/ bskyangs pa nam 'kha' mdzod du/ dge bsnyen ston pa bod de ra tsa dang*/ ras pa zhi ba 'od la sogs pa bcu tsam gyis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thang sku dang*/ tsa ka li 'dres pa tshan gcig la rab gnas zhus pa la/ me tog mi gtor bar zhugs pa la khong na re/ rje btsun la me tog gtor mi gtor mi mnga' yang*/ nged kyi rtog pa bsal pa'i phyir/ me tog gtor bar zhu byas pas/

nga mi la rgas pa me tog gtor mi nus byas pas/ dgos na lha rang longs byas pas/ tsa ka li dang thang sku'i lha rnams byon pas/ me tog yar re blangs bas so so'i thugs kar klan bas/ nyin zhag gcig la ma gog der dad pa skyes pas/ phyag 'tshal zhing ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ thub pa chos kyi sku can kyi// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sa gzhi la*// me tog gzugs sku dri med dag /len kyang de nyid yin snyams med// zhes gsungs so// ༈ bcu bzhi pa sems la dbang thob pa'i yon tan ni/ ngan tshong ras pa dang*/ yon bdag mo le ges la sogs bcu tsam gyis dbang bskur zhus pas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham nas/ khrus dang sngon 'gro byas te/ ye shes phabs pas byin rlabs rang 'bar du byung ste/ bum pa dbang bskur kar ras kyi dbu 'phur nas bzhugs pa la/ nga mi la rgas pas dbang bskur mi nus/ dgos na bum pa rang gis gyis gsungs pas/ bum pa de nam mkha' la lding shing byung bas/ khong rnams kyi 'go thog tu dbang bskur shing khrus byas pas/ rje btsun ngo mtshar che byas pas/ snyan rgyud dri med dkyil 'khor du/ zhen pa med pa'i mchod bshams nas// sangs rgyas ye shes ngo sprad nas// chu dbang dri ma med par bskur// bskur yang de nyid yin snyams med// zhes gsungs so// ༈ bco lnga pa mngon par shes pa mnga' ba'i yon tan ni/ she'u phug nam mkha' rdzong zhes bya ba'i/ nags khrod der bzhugs pa'i dus su/ yon bdag gcig gis bsnyen bkur skyel ba'i lam khar nag gseb gcig tu stag byung bas/ bla mas mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba btabs pas/ yon bdag la stag gis ma tshugs pas 'di skad gsungs/ ri khrod 'grim ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i// mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i yon bdag la// stag sogs 'jigs pa byed pa yi/ bar chad mkha' 'gro ma rang sol/ ces gsungs so// ༈ bcu drug pa byin rlabs phul du phyin pa'i yon tan ni/ slob ma gcig shing gis mnan bas rma byung ba la/

rma 'bras su song bas sos su ma nyan ba la/ bla mas byin rlabs byas pa tsam gyis sos te/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ rlung gi rkyen kyis lhung ba yi/ sems med shing gis gnod pa yi/ 'bras kyi zer zug mi bzod pa'i// sman sbyor mkha' 'gro ma yis byas// zhes gsungs so// ༈ bcu bdun pa 'byung ba dbang 'dus pa'i yon tan ni/ dus res shig na dpon slob 'ga' sta so brag kar nas phar 'gro ba'i dus su/ bla ma mkhar rtsags ma brgya tsam la dbab tu song ba las/ slob ma rnams kyis bskor nas phyin te/ ngu shin phyin tsam na/ bla ma bzhengs nas byon te/ ma bsdig sam byas pas/ gzhan yin na sha yang dum bu dum bur 'gro ste/ nga la mi bde ba bag tsam yang ma byung ste/ brul sar bal 'dab brdabs pa tsam pa las ma byung gsungs nas/ da dus 'di nas bzungs nas nga'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa thams cad la/ bdud kyis bar du gcod pas mi tshugs pa yin gsungs ste/ rje btsun gyi 'chi bdag gi bdud dang*/ phung po'i bdud bcom pa yin gsungs/ de'i dus su// zung 'jug thang kar gshog brkyangs nas/ 'phur ba brag gar rtse nas 'phur// babs pa dro khung shod du babs// myong ba bde stong dbyer med myongs// grol ba 'khor 'das shugs las grol// phrad pa bde stong dngos su phrad/ da yongs grol dgos mi snyams so// rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog 'di// srog 'jigs brag dmar gshed ma yi// bdud las mkha' 'gro ma yis drangs// da yongs bdud kyis khyer snyams med/ zhes gsungs so// ༈ bco brgyad pa 'bras bu la re ba med pa'i yon tan ni// yang sku 'gres ka tsam na/ bla ma dwags po chen po byon nas dri ba mdzad pas/ nged kyi ma ki na bsgrub pa po 'di 'dra ba'i bag re yod de/ ci tsam slebs zhus pas/ yang 'di skad gsungs// mi bzad nam mkha'i mdzod lta bu// ting 'dzin sems kyi g.yo skor gyis// bkres skoms zas kyi 'dun pa dang*// bral ba mkha' 'gro mas kyang byed// de yang grub thob yin snyams med// sems kyi ngo bo mthong 'gyur zhing*/

ma rig mun pa spangs pa na// zhal lta mkha' 'gro mas kyang byed// chos nyid klong la lta snyams byed// de yang grub thob yin snyams med// gang yang skye ba med pa yi// rang nyid rang byung stong pa nyid// chos lta mkha' 'gro mas kyang ston// de yang grub thob yin snyams med// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// dgos pa thams cad bsgrub byed ltar// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i// dngos grub thams cad tshe 'di ru// grub ces mkha' 'gro mas kyang gsungs// de yang grub thob yin snyams med/ zhes gsungs so// ༈ bcu dgu pa sku'i spyod yul mdzad pa'i tshul sna tshogs su bstan pa'i yon tan ni/ yang dus gcig gi tshe/ nags mthongs gcig tu bzhugs tsam na/ mi gcig phyin bas rtsar la rog par bsdad/ dar gcig tshur bltas nas song*/ der bos nas khyod ci 'dod dris pas/ bla ma 'dod ste ngas ma mthong*// mchod rten dkar po gcig 'dug pa sems zer/ yang dus gcig tsam na dgon pa gcig na bzhugs pa la/ mi gcig byung bas ma mthong bar gda'/ de zad par nam mkha'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i dus yin skad/ yang dus gcig tsam na/ 'khor mang po dang 'grogs nas song ba la/ bla ma nam mkha' la ldengs nas bzhugs pas/ 'khor rnams kyis rjes ma slebs skad/ phyis dris nas de bzhin zhus pas/ lding sa ni med de rlung en tsam gcig mnan nas phyin bas kha ba la bya rjes tsam las ma byung gsungs skad do// yang zhag bcu gnyis tsam la phye phul res chog par byung zer ba bden nam byas pas mi med pa'i dus su/ mkha' 'gro ma mang po byung bas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas pa'i tshogs mang po 'dren pa byung bas/ de'i nyams kyi myong bas zhag bcu re la zas ye ma dran bar byung gsungs/ gzhan ma lus kyi bkod pa'am/ mi snang bar mdzad pa'am/ seng ge la bcibs nas bar snang la gshegs pa'am/ spyod pa rtul shugs che bas/ breng yi chu bar du bzhugs pa'i dus su/

'jig rten gyi lha 'dre thams cad 'dus te dmag drangs pas/ lha srin sde brgyad/ bkra shis tshe ring 'khor dang bcas pas dmag drangs pa'i dus su/ bar du ma chod par slar zil gyis mnan te/ dam la thogs te lha'i bu'i bdud bcoms pa'o// gung thang gi brag dmar ling bar bzhugs pa'i dus su/ brag srin mo la sogs pas/ bar du ma chod de/ slar bzod gsol byas pa dang*/ la phyi chu bzangs su lha 'dre thams cad la mgur bzhengs pas/ slar thul te zla ba gcig tu bshos drangs pa dang*/ de la sogs pa dpag tu med pa mnga' ste/ 'di skad gsungs/ ༈ nga snang ba sems su thag chod cing*// sems nyid chos skur thag chod pas// 'dre khyod kyi cho 'phrul cir bstan yang*// nga rnal 'byor pa yi rgyan du che// zhes gsungs pa'o// de la sogs pa'i yon tan ni/ che long zhig bris pa yin te/ rgyas par ni brjod kyi mi langs pa yin no// ༈ nyi shu pa 'od gsal dri ma med pa'i ngang du/ sku gsum dbyer med du gyur pas/ srid pa'i bar mdo mi mthong zhing 'bras bu sku gsum rang dang gzhan kyi don 'byung ba'i yon tan ni/ breng yi chu bar na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nam zhig tsam na rje btsun gyis sku 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas/ de'i dus su slob ma rnams kyis rtogs pa mthon dman dang bsam pa tha dad kyi khyad par mthong snang tha dad sna tshogs su shar ba'i don gsungs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcoms pas 'od gsal dang po'i dus su// chos sku mngon du gyur pa ston cing*/ bla ma nyid kyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtags kyi 'char tshul la sogs pa byung tshul gsungs te/ rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog 'di// 'chi bdag rkyen kyis bar do yis// bdud rnams bcoms te pha rol 'gro tsam na// bar do mthong med rnal 'byor bde// bdud rnams bcoms te pha rol 'gro// de dus mkha' spyod gnas su 'pho// dag pa'i sgyu lus zhen med 'di// phu yul rdzogs pa'i bar do der// snyan rgyud zab mos 'tshams sbyar nas// bla ma yi dam 'od gsal gyi// skyel bsu skye med lam khrid nas// yon tan rdzogs pa'i bar do ru// nga la mthong ba sna tshogs 'ong*// yid bzhin nor bu gshegs shul du// la la ngu zhing la la dga'// brgyal zhing mya ngan byed dus su// rang byung me ni 'bar 'gyur nas/

du ba 'ja' tshon ltar 'khrigs shing*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil// me sgra dung dang cha lang dang*// pi wang dha ma ru yi sgra// me stag skar ma ltar 'phro bas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa byed// dha ki du mas sprin gtibs te// sprul sku 'phrin las char rgyun kyi// gdul bya'i lo tog bsnyen bar byed// gang yang skye ba med pa yi// chos nyid skye med stong pa nyid// stong pa nyid ni skye 'gag bral// de la the tshom ci byar yod// ces gsungs so// de ltar dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis la/ bya'i lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma rtse shar ba'i dus su'o/ phyis rje btsun 'da' ba'i tshul yod pa dang*/ med par mthong ba'i bye brag de lta bu snang ba byung ste// der bla ma mkha' spyod du gshegs nas/ spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad cing rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing*/ la las ni bla ma seng ge la bcibs nas/ nam mkha' la dha ki ma dang bcas pa bzhud par mthong ba ni/ dbang po rab kyi gang zag gis mthong*/ la las mthong ba ni bla ma 'da' tshul bstan nas/ dha ki ma dpag tu med pa byon nas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i pu tsa dpag tu med pa bshams nas/ gdung bzhu ba la bkra shis pa'i rtags/ rol mo dang*/ 'ja' tshon gyi 'od dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla bres dang pi wang dang*/ dha ma ru'i sgra dang*/ sil snyan sna tshogs dang*/ mchod pa'i bye brag mang du byung ste gdung rus rangs pa ring srel gyi phung por gyur pas/ nam mkha' la dha ki ma'i sar gdan drangs par mthong de ltar bla ma chos sku mngon du gyur zhing*/ longs spyod rdzogs sku shugs la shar/ sprul sku sna tshogs phyogs bcur khyab pas/ 'gro ba 'dren ba'i 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad do// de dag ni sku gsum lhun kyi grub pas/ bla ma mi la ras pa chen po'i rnams thar brda don grol byed las/

le'u bzhi pa'o// snyan rgyud gsang ba dri med gdams pa yis// sprul sku'i rnam thar yi ger bkod byas te// phyi rab skal ldan sems can don slad du// bla ma la zhus gong ma'i bka' lung bzhin// dha ki dpang btsugs rang dran don phyir min// lha la gsol btabs ngan song ston pa yis// bsgrub rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i bdud rtsi 'thungs// nyi ma'i 'od bzhin mun sel 'di bris pas// sa stengs skal ldan rnams dang phrad par shog /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi yang snying*/ gsang ba'i snying po bo de ra tsas/ zhe 'dod med pa'i snying rjes kun bslangs nas/ yi ger bkod pa'o// 'di phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi nyams len la brtson pa 'ga' zhig gi don du bris pa las/ gal te bka' las 'gal na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bzod par gsol// zhe 'dod kyis kun nas slangs nas bdag rang na ra gan/ /de ltar rje btsun mid la'i slob ma/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun du bsten pa'i ngan tshong ras pa/ de'i thugs kyi sras gung ras pa/ dam pa des byin gyi brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba rgya'i ldom bu ba yin no/// /
